versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of grepwrapper skill (v0.3.0).
- Enables searching exact code matches across public GitHub repositories using the grepwrapper CLI and grep.app.
- Supports advanced search options: case-sensitivity, whole-word, regexp mode, and pagination.
- Returns summarized results with match counts and GitHub locations.
- Includes usage guide, installation instructions, and agent behavior recommendations.
